title: VERDA Daily Hydrating Shampoo with Aloe & Oat, 400 mL / 13.5 fl oz
altText: VERDA Daily Hydrating Shampoo in a matte sage bottle with a white flip-top cap, 400 mL
bullets: Daily Hydrating Shampoo for a calm, simple everyday routine
Cleanses hair as part of your daily wash
description:
Daily Hydrating Shampoo is made for the quiet, unhurried minutes of your morning or evening shower. Massage into wet hair, take a slow breath, and rinse. It cleanses hair as part of a simple daily ritual and brings 72-hour hydration to your routine.

The formula is made with aloe and oat, two familiar botanicals that suit a calm, understated approach to everyday hair care. There is nothing complicated here, just a shampoo you can reach for each day without a second thought, whether you are rushing out the door or taking your time at the end of the day.

Use it on its own or follow with the conditioner of your choice. Massage into wet hair, rinse, and repeat if you like. Keep it within easy reach so it becomes a natural part of the way you wash.

The 400 mL / 13.5 fl oz size is made for regular use, so it can settle into your shower and stay there, ready whenever you are. Daily Hydrating Shampoo from VERDA keeps the routine plain, botanical and easy to return to, wash after wash.
shortDescription: Daily Hydrating Shampoo is made for the quiet, unhurried minutes of your shower. Massage into wet hair, rinse, and enjoy 72-hour hydration. Made with aloe and oat for a calm, botanical approach to everyday hair care.
